card.name: Quiz and exam question wording
card.fires_on: Words in exam or quiz items that set up a question, such as the verb after "Which of the statements below", "False" or "false" in true/false items, and "from" in ordering instructions.

modes.label: Verb in question stem
modes.description: A linking verb right after a multiple-choice stem such as "statements below" or "following responses".
